Selected list and paid-order/payment-bound mutations are awaited. Zero-row capture updates and missing uncollected targets retain uncertainty. Existing quarantine, shipment hold and alert enqueue commit together; no new migrations or idempotency keys.
Existing getPayment/completePayment HTTP calls await parsed responses. The caller now checks requested identity and completed capture acknowledgement.
Selected recipient lookup and every transactional alert enqueue are awaited via allSettled before any failure propagation.
Existing local configured alert recipient lookup.
Existing transactional alert enqueue and duplicate-key handling. Delivery is owned by an independent worker.
Existing local payload encryption; no sensitive material enters admission records.
Selected local encryption-key configuration only; no Sanity read/write is introduced.
Existing selected pool/Drizzle queries and transactions are awaited.
Unchanged business database connection configuration.
Unchanged static schema; no migration.
Existing local enable/config lookup. Disabled commerce skips capture admission.
Synchronous console diagnostics only.

Unchanged source/producer/environment/application-and-ledger target validation; disabled by default.
Unchanged local environment/project binding.
Unchanged TLS/identity/current-policy binding, operation lifetime and awaited settlement, without replay.
